routes.title: Appalachian Ohio — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: The roads start bending, the hills gather around you, and Ohio changes its rhythm. The southeast’s landscape and lived regional identity are worth getting to know at a thoughtful pace.

routes.title: A constellation of cities — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Lakefront Cleveland, central Columbus, riverfront Cincinnati… where to first? Each city has its own personality, and the places between them have plenty to say too. ♡

routes.title: A layered history — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: There’s a deeper story beneath every familiar landmark. Ohio’s history includes Indigenous nations, forced displacement, migration, industry, reform, and communities still shaping what comes next.

routes.title: Wild Ohio — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A marsh at sunrise, a forest path, a river bend… Ohio has plenty of reasons to slow down. Let’s trade the checklist for a little patient looking—and enjoy the quiet. ♡

routes.title: The buckeye state — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A swallow-tailed flag, a bright red bird, and a shiny brown nut. Ohio’s symbols make a sweet little treasure hunt. Ready to spot them?

routes.title: Hocking Hills — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ooh, this is the Ohio that makes you put your phone away—after one waterfall photo, obviously. Sandstone gorges, forest paths, and a very tempting overnight stay.

routes.title: Cuyahoga Valley — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Wait, a national park between Cleveland and Akron? Yep! Follow the river, find a waterfall, or let the old canal towpath turn a short walk into an afternoon.

routes.title: Lake Erie Islands — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ooh, ferry day! Lively village streets, quieter beaches, or a long bicycle ride—the islands have different personalities. Let’s pick the one that feels like your kind of escape.

routes.title: Cleveland — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ooh, music history, art, neighborhood food, and a whole lake at the edge of town. Cleveland has plenty of ways to steal your afternoon—in the best way. ♡

routes.title: Columbus — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ahh, the Statehouse, a science museum, an arts district, a riverside stroll… Columbus, you’re making it very difficult to choose. Let’s build the day around your favorite things.

routes.title: Cincinnati — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Cincinnati brings river views, hillside neighborhoods, art, markets, and food traditions that are very much their own. We can argue about the chili later.

routes.title: Dayton — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A bicycle shop, a flying field, and extraordinary aircraft: Dayton lets you follow an idea into the sky. There’s more than one remarkable life story here, too, so take your time.

routes.title: Marblehead Lighthouse — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Hey, I’ve got a Lake Erie view for you: a lighthouse at the peninsula’s edge, with the whole lake opening beyond it ♡

routes.title: Wayne’s covered bridge road — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ooh, a winding river road passes forested hills and covered bridges. The slower route is the lovely one, isn’t it?

routes.title: Toledo’s Glass Pavilion — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: In Toledo’s Glass City, even the museum walls join the exhibition. The pavilion changes as you move. ♡

routes.title: Magee Marsh — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A small bird can make a very big journey. Lake Erie’s migrating songbirds reward quiet steps and sharp eyes. ♡

routes.title: Serpent Mound — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A great earthen serpent curls across a ridge. I’ll guide you through this Indigenous place with care, curiosity, and respect.

routes.title: Glen Helen — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A spring, a cascade, and a forest path near town. Glen Helen rewards slow steps and a little curiosity about what’s growing. ♡

routes.title: Hopewell Earthworks — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: These extraordinary earthworks invite us to slow down and listen. Their geometry belongs to a much deeper story of Indigenous knowledge, community, and enduring cultural meaning.

routes.title: Aviation & invention — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: The bicycle shop before the airplane—that’s the detail I love. Dayton’s aviation story makes room for patient experiments, practical skills, and the people around a big idea. Follow the steps and see how it takes shape.

routes.title: Music with a pulse — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Turn it up a little. Cleveland’s rock legacy is one way into Ohio’s music story, but local stages, recordings, and the people in the crowd keep it moving.

routes.title: Arts & museums — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ooh, big collections or a tiny gallery you almost walked past? We have room for both. Ohio’s creative life stretches well beyond one museum district—and that’s where a lovely surprise might be waiting.

routes.title: Regional foodways — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Now this is a map I can get excited about: chili, goetta, neighborhood bakeries, markets, and recipes carried across generations. Ohio tastes different from place to place.

routes.title: Sports & gathering — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Hear that? Game-day noise has a way of spilling into the whole neighborhood. Sports, festivals, and local celebrations turn an ordinary day into a shared one.

routes.title: An evening at Severance — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: At Severance, home to The Cleveland Orchestra, a seat and a little time let the music do its thing.

routes.title: Freedom stories by the river — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: The Ohio River runs right beside this Cincinnati museum, where the setting and the history meet thoughtfully and carefully.

routes.title: West Side Market — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Look up at that tiled vault, then take in the counters. Generations of neighbors have shaped this Cleveland market.

routes.title: A home for cartoon art — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A comic panel can make you laugh and carry history, too. At Ohio State, both sides of the page have a story.

routes.title: The signs we live by — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A sign catches your eye and can hold a whole street’s memory. Cincinnati has saved plenty of them. ♡

routes.title: Cincinnati Music Hall — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: One grand building, so many kinds of sound. I’ll take you beyond the facade to see how Cincinnati keeps Music Hall alive.

routes.title: Many kinds of work — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Factories, farms, hospitals, campuses, offices—Ohio’s economy is a lot of connected lives. Let’s follow the pieces, and keep an eye on what each big number can actually tell us.

routes.title: Making things — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Pick almost any finished product and start tracing it backward. Ohio’s manufacturing story quickly becomes a web of materials, skills, suppliers, and journeys between places.

routes.title: Work & household budgets — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A statewide average can’t tell you what every household’s day feels like. Wages, hours, stability, housing, and the trip to work all belong in the picture.

routes.title: Trade & movement — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ports, interstates, rail lines, airports—Ohio has a lot of ways to send things on their way. Those routes carry local work to much wider markets. Let’s follow where they lead.

routes.title: The Port of Toledo — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Wait, what happens after a lake freighter docks? I’ll trace Toledo’s cargo from the waterfront toward the rail lines and roads beyond.

routes.title: Advanced manufacturing — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Robots get the dramatic photos, but the really interesting part is how people improve the whole process. Ohio’s manufacturing connects careful design with things that actually get made.

routes.title: Aerospace & defense — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: An aircraft has a very long supporting cast. Materials, software, precision parts, testing, maintenance—Ohio’s aviation story is still finding new ways to take shape.

routes.title: Automotive & mobility — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Let’s peek under the hood. Ohio’s vehicle industry stretches from assembly and engines to electronics, batteries, testing, and all the suppliers between them.

routes.title: Healthcare & life sciences — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A discovery in a lab has quite a journey before it can help a patient. Ohio’s health systems, universities, manufacturers, and researchers work at different points along that path.

routes.title: Food & agribusiness — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: That grocery shelf has a backstory. Farms, processors, packaging, cold storage, equipment, and delivery all help turn what grows into what reaches our tables.

routes.title: Logistics & distribution — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Things don’t get where they’re going by wishing very hard. Roads, rail, air, water, planning, and people keep Ohio’s farms, factories, shops, and customers connected.

routes.title: Technology — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Code doesn’t always live in an app on your phone. In Ohio, it can help a factory make a part, support a medical tool, or follow freight across the map.

routes.title: Energy & chemicals — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Power, coatings, polymers, fuels—some of Ohio’s most widely used products work quietly behind the scenes. Let’s follow the materials, with the practical questions still in view.

routes.title: The ice inside NASA Glenn — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A wind tunnel that makes ice? Ooh, Cleveland researchers put aircraft to a very cold test.

routes.title: East Liverpool in clay — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Kilns helped shape East Liverpool. The Museum of Ceramics tells the story of the hands behind its pottery. ♡

routes.title: A whistle from Columbus — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: That little whistle has quite a making story. Columbus turns brass into a clear, piercing signal.

routes.title: Rookwood's Cincinnati clay — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A tile can belong to a building and still be a little work of art. Cincinnati’s Rookwood makers have explored that since 1880. ♡

routes.title: Akron and the rubber road — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Before Akron tires rolled everywhere, local factories made all kinds of rubber goods. That work grew into a citywide industry.

routes.title: More than one Ohio accent — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Drive across Ohio and listen closely: the vowels have their own geography. A state border doesn’t give everyone the same accent. Wouldn’t a little variety make the conversation more interesting?

routes.title: Appalachian English — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A voice can carry family, place, and a lifetime of conversations. Appalachian English is varied and expressive; let’s listen with curiosity and let speakers tell their own stories.

routes.title: Names worth asking about — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Scioto, Cuyahoga, Bellefontaine… a familiar-looking spelling can still catch you by surprise. No shame in asking. Local names are an invitation to listen.

routes.title: Many languages, many homes — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: English is only part of what you’ll hear here. Ohio’s families and communities bring many languages into classrooms, neighborhoods, and everyday conversations. What a lovely chorus.

routes.title: Executive branch — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A law passes, then a whole team has work to do. Ohio’s governor, statewide offices, and agencies carry out the laws and run public services. Let’s meet the offices behind the day-to-day details.

routes.title: Legislative branch — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A bill has quite a journey before it becomes law. Ohio’s House and Senate consider proposals, debate budgets, and leave a public record you can follow. Ready to see each step?

routes.title: Judicial branch — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Courts resolve disputes and apply the law. Ohio has several kinds, each with its own role—so let’s get our bearings before we follow a case through the system.

routes.title: Closer to home — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: The Statehouse isn’t the only place decisions happen. Counties, cities, villages, and townships handle work closer to home, with responsibilities that depend on the place and service. Let’s find the right local door.

routes.title: Step inside the Statehouse — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ohio lawmakers meet in this building, whose halls and museum bring state government into view.

routes.title: Universities across Ohio — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ooh, big campus, small college, a technical program close to home—Ohio has more than one way to be a student. Let’s find the questions that matter to you. ♡

routes.title: Research & discovery — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A good question can travel a long way. Ohio’s labs, hospitals, campuses, museums, and research partnerships give curious people places to follow it. Ooh, where might yours lead?

routes.title: Learning at every age — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Learning doesn’t end at one age or follow one neat route. Ohio’s schools and career programs connect classroom ideas with practical skills. Let’s see what you’d like to learn next.

routes.title: Libraries for everyone — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ahh, books are only the beginning, which is excellent news for curious people. Ohio’s libraries also offer research, digital access, local history, learning programs, and a place to settle in.

routes.title: Community life — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ooh, a town starts feeling different when you meet the people who gather there. Libraries, local groups, festivals, faith communities, and volunteers help make that happen.

routes.title: A bigger library shelf — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ahh, one book can lead to shelves all across Ohio. That’s the library network at work. ♡

routes.title: Try it at COSI — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Hey, at COSI you can test a question with your own hands. I want to see what you try first.

routes.title: Stories in Wilberforce — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Art, objects, and documents tell Black histories at Wilberforce’s National Afro-American Museum & Cultural Center. Begin with what draws your eye.

routes.title: A nature center afternoon — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A peek at the exhibits, then a walk toward the river? I have just the afternoon in mind at Rocky River Nature Center.

routes.title: Grow something together — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: At Dayton’s Possum Creek MetroPark, a garden plot brings a season of shared work and new skills. Ooh, I like having a reason to return ♡

routes.title: What took flight. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: The bicycle shop before the airplane—that’s my favorite place to begin. Come follow Dayton’s patient experiments into the sky.

routes.description: You pick the ride; I’m saving a little time for the bay. A Sandusky overnight gives both kinds of fun room to breathe. ♡

routes.description: That tiny whistle has such a big voice! Let me show you the cuts, curves, and careful listening behind a Columbus-made signal.

routes.title: A little clay. A lot of hands. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: I’m drawn to the glaze first. Then I want to know who made that curve. Come look a little closer at Cincinnati’s Rookwood Pottery.

routes.title: Ooh, look at that glass. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ooh, move a little—the light changed! Toledo’s glass story is one I’d happily linger over with you.

routes.title: There’s a story in these tires. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Ooh, a whole city behind an ordinary tire. Come follow Akron’s rubber story with me, from the workbench to the neighborhood.

routes.title: Pull up a chair. Let’s order chili. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: First chili-parlor order? I’ll help with the numbers. You can tell me whether onions or beans win a place on your plate.

routes.title: Save room for a buckeye. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: I’d pick the slightly wonky one. Peanut butter, chocolate, and a little pale circle make a very sweet introduction to Ohio. ♡

routes.title: A market full of good things. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: I’d look at the ceiling, then let the bread distract me. Come take a slow lap of Cleveland’s West Side Market before we choose.

routes.title: A book, a window, an afternoon. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A book by the window, a question about an old house… ahh, I could linger. Come find your own quiet corner at Columbus Main Library.

routes.title: Let’s see what’s growing. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: I like a place that gives us a reason to come back. At Possum Creek, a shared garden has something different to notice each month.

routes.title: Got a little time? Let’s walk through Athens. — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: College Green, a little Uptown wandering, and time to sit together. I’d leave this Athens afternoon pleasantly unhurried. ♡

routes.title: How an Ohio object takes shape — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A little whistle, a curve in the clay—ooh, I want a closer look. Let’s meet the work behind a few Ohio objects.

routes.title: A whistle in cross-section — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A moving pea helps give a whistle its trill. Ooh, come look at the tiny chamber behind that familiar sound.

routes.title: What survives the kiln? — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A Rookwood form changes through firing and glaze. I’d look twice at the surface; the little variations catch my eye. ♡

routes.description: Shh, there’s a frog in this part. A canal song, a Columbus conversation, a marsh: come get to know Ohio by ear with me.

routes.description: A recorded song, its written words, and the records kept around it. I’d listen twice and see what the second pass reveals.

routes.title: What is an accent sample? — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Forty Columbus speakers, many conversations. I like listening for differences rather than one voice for all of Ohio.

routes.title: A book’s trip through Ohio — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: A request at your own library can send a book traveling between shared shelves. I like a reading adventure that begins close to home. ♡

routes.description: Wait, before we head for the stalls—look at this block with me. Findlay Street’s maps have a few surprises tucked into their lines.

routes.description: A fire-insurance map describes buildings through its own little marks. Keep the legend beside us; there’s quite a lot to notice.

routes.title: Markets and changing edges — Oh, Ohio

routes.title: Water has a working life — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Lake Erie’s view makes me curious about the water’s other journeys. Follow the Cuyahoga, the harbor, and the work behind your tap with me.

routes.title: A canal corridor on paper — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: The canal links rivers through engineered channels and summit works. Come follow the little turns in the map with me.

routes.title: Lake water, public service — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Cleveland’s drinking water starts offshore. Ooh, the lake view has a connection to home I’d like to follow.

routes.title: Who keeps Ohio’s memory? — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: An old photograph makes me wonder about a name. Come meet the people and collections keeping Ohio’s stories within reach.

routes.title: An oral history is one person’s account — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: An interview keeps one person’s experience in their own voice. Let’s give the narrator and their story a little time.

routes.description: The Eastern Shawnee Tribe of Oklahoma shares a digital library through Ohio Memory. Let’s begin with the Tribe’s own collection and descriptions.

routes.title: Small towns, many centers — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: I’d leave room for a small-town afternoon. Yellow Springs and Nelsonville each deserve their own day—and a little time to sit.

routes.title: Glen Helen is a place people have shaped — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: Glen Helen’s history includes choices people made to care for the land. I’d keep those stories with us on the path.

routes.title: Before boarding in Nelsonville — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: The railway lists access by coach and asks visitors to call ahead. I’d settle those details before planning our valley day.

routes.description: Market morning or aviation afternoon? Tell me what you’re excited about, and we’ll build one comfortable Ohio day around it.

routes.title: A Cincinnati day in selected stops — Oh, Ohio
routes.description: The Connector map lets us choose a short trip between market, park, and downtown. I’d leave time to linger at your favorite stop.

routes.description: Some Dayton aviation stops suit a transit-first day; others need another ride. Let’s sort out the journey before choosing our favorites.
